Kaiju 0.9.12 beta

  • Set list slot transpose: Kaiju now reads and writes it. Set it in the slot's panel (Transpose); a transposed slot shows a small up or down chevron with the semitones.
  • Fix: transposed slots pointed at nothing. Their combi or program wasn't found, and editing one lost part of the transpose. Both are fixed, and sorting or compacting banks keeps each slot's transpose.
  • Fix: slots playing a GM program no longer jump to I-A 000 when Kaiju rewrites them (editing, importing, sorting).
  • Preview: the slot's button starts hidden so the notes get the whole screen ("Show slot" brings it back), and the three suns try the KRONOS' notes brightness (a general setting of the keyboard, not saved in the PCG).
  • Welcome screen: the "Continue" card has an × (and right-click › Remove from Recents), so a single recent file can be cleared too.
  • Convert to Nautilus (experimental): set list slots whose program lands in a Nautilus bank a slot can't point at are now listed as unplaced instead of being written wrong.

Kaiju 0.9.11 beta

  • Set lists look like the KRONOS screen: the yellow bar over the slots shows the slot you're editing (name, sound and notes, before you apply them), slots come 4 per row in their full colors, and the font sizes are XS, S, M, L and XL as the KRONOS stores them.
  • Preview: the button in a slot's panel shows the slot on the KRONOS' Set List screen, with the notes at the size the keyboard uses and cut where it cuts them. "Hide slot" appears when the notes reach the slot's button.
  • Tools › Set list slots that play nothing: finds slots pointing at an empty combi or program, or at a user bank this PCG doesn't have, and empties the ones you tick in one step (Undo brings them back).
  • EXi engines: an EXi program's panel shows its engines (for example SGX-2 + MOD-7), and Organize › Sort › Sort by engine groups an EXi bank by engine. HD-1 / EXi is now called "Bank type".
  • Drum Track patterns: select several and delete them, or delete the unused ones or all of them.
  • Import:
    • the bank picker shows where things will go, and choosing another bank moves them there;
    • the bank buttons land on the bank with one click;
    • INT banks can be destinations, and adding missing banks no longer freezes the window;
    • Set Lists shows only the chosen PCG's set lists;
    • "Continue editing PCG" takes you to where the import went.
  • ⌘C, ⌘X and ⌘V always work on the selected set list slots (⌘V sometimes did nothing).
  • Kaiju opens at about 1580 × 1200 (or most of a smaller screen).
  • The header buttons no longer jump on the first edit, and "Save as new PCG…" is now "Save as…".
  • Recent files lists only PCGs, sample banks and folders.
  • Fix: sorting an INT bank no longer changes empty combis that point at it.

Kaiju 0.9.10 beta

  • Fix: playing samples could freeze the keyboard. Now and then a key press in Multisamples left the keyboard stuck and silent, and Close no longer updated the sidebar. The audio engine is no longer rebuilt on every note, and a change of audio device (headphones, a call) is handled.
  • Sample Builder › Volume › Even out + normalize: every sample is brought to the same loudness before the multisample is raised to full level, so one note recorded much louder no longer holds the others down. "Normalize" (raise it all as one, keeping the balance) is still there, and saving a big bank no longer freezes the window.
  • Delete a sample from an existing bank: Multisamples › choose a zone › Delete…. Both sides of a stereo pair go, its keys go to the next zone, the other samples are numbered again, and the file and the bank as it was are kept in Kaiju's sample backups.
  • Compare two versions of a bank: switching between open files keeps the same multisample and zone selected.
  • Convert to Nautilus (experimental): Tools › Convert to Nautilus… writes a Nautilus PCG with a KRONOS PCG's programs, combis, wave sequences, drum kits and set lists, and says what it couldn't convert. Please try the result on a Nautilus before relying on it.
  • Texts say KRONOS or Nautilus (following the PCG on screen) instead of "the keyboard".
  • The sample bank's RAM total follows samples you edit or delete.
  • Set list EQ: a taller graph, proportioned like the KRONOS'; the fader values fit a small window.
  • App icons: the Set List and Combi looks come first; Flower is gone.

Kaiju 0.9.9 beta

  • Set list slot colors are now the KRONOS' own 16 (Default, Charcoal, Brick, Burgundy, Ivy, Olive, Gold, Cacao, Indigo, Navy, Rose, Lavender, Azure, Denim, Silver, Slate), in its order and shades, and the slot's color picker is the KRONOS' 4 × 4 grid with their names. Before, Kaiju showed approximate colors (e.g. Charcoal looked red).
  • Rubber-band selection (⌥ + drag): the cursor goes back to the arrow when you let go of ⌥; it stayed a crosshair.
  • Empty slots of the KRONOS 2 "RED SE" PRELOAD (U-CC / U-DD 032–127) are recognised as empty, so Kaiju sees all the free space.
  • With a long PCG name in a narrow window, the header buttons move to the second row instead of being cut short.

Kaiju 0.9.8 beta

  • Unify the combis' default sound (new, Tools menu): a master PCG made from several libraries parks unused timbres on each library's own default program (e.g. a KRONOS 3 Berlin Grand), which shows red tracks with "Samples not loaded" on a keyboard without it. Kaiju points them all at the program you choose. Only timbres that can't sound change, so no combi sounds different.
  • Erase combis and their programs (new): when erasing combis, a second button also empties the programs only those combis use (and the wave sequences / drum kits only those use). Anything another combi, set list or Drum Track uses stays; factory banks are never touched. One Undo step.
  • Import set lists without the rest: "Only sounds already in this PCG" brings a set list pointing at the combis you already have and leaves its other slots empty, for "light" PCGs. Each set list shows how many slots stay empty.
  • Combis imported earlier are recognised in any slot, so importing a set list later doesn't copy them again.
  • Paste and "Bring here" from another PCG follow the factory programs you moved in your PCG and adapt the KRONOS / X ↔ 2 / 3 order, as Import does.
  • Each open PCG keeps its own import: look at another PCG and come back, the import is as you left it.
  • Import step 1: a bank index above the list jumps straight to a bank.
  • Multisamples tab: shows only the sample banks this PCG plays; other banks in the same folder appear apart ("Others in the folder").
  • "+" to add a bank is now a round button, appears even when a PCG has no user banks of that kind (e.g. a library's combis), and works with only that PCG open.
  • Window: opens larger (most of the screen), with a minimum size where nothing overlaps; toolbars and buttons rearrange in a narrow window.
  • Multisamples: zones without a sample ("SKIPPEDSAMPL") show as silent keys; a black-key zone is outlined only over that key.

Kaiju 0.9.7 beta

  • Optimize space (new): gathers the sounds of the user banks of each type (HD-1 and EXi programs, combis, wave sequences, drum kits) at the start, so the gaps end up together and whole banks free up. It shows what it will free before doing anything; combis, set lists and Drum Tracks follow their sounds.
  • Duplicates (new): finds programs that are exactly the same sound (same name, same settings, same drum kits and wave sequences), keeps one of each and points everything that used the copies to it. Programs that only share a name are left alone.
  • Init Bank (new): right-click a user bank to empty it, or all user banks at once, for a blank slate that keeps your INT banks. It lists what uses those sounds first.
  • New blank PCG asks whether it's for the KRONOS or the Nautilus.
  • Keyboard shortcuts panel in the Help menu (⌘/).
  • Status bar: shows which keyboard the open PCG is for (KRONOS / KRONOS X, KRONOS 2 / 3 or Nautilus).
  • Combis: the track count now recognises the program a PCG parks its unused timbres on, whatever slot or name it has: your own piano on I-A 000, or a KRONOS 3 piano imported into a user slot.
  • Save As is always available and can save over the original file (Kaiju keeps a backup of it).
  • Fixes: the selection clears after erasing slots, so the side panel and the "selected" count no longer show slots that are gone.

Kaiju 0.9.6 beta

  • Sample Builder (new): make your own sample banks for the KRONOS from WAV, AIFF, MP3, M4A/AAC, FLAC or CAF files, or import SFZ and SoundFont (SF2) instruments. Samples go on their keys by the file's root key, its name ("Strings C3") or by listening to their pitch; a run of files recorded one semitone apart fills in by itself. Set root and top keys by pressing a key (⌥-click / ⇧-click), and edit each sample: trim, cut, fades, normalize, gain and loop points that snap to zero crossings, with a time ruler and vertical zoom. Saving writes the .KSC, its UserBank and the samples the way the KRONOS does, and adds the bank to your open files.
  • Edit samples of an existing bank from the Multisamples tab (both sides of a stereo pair together). Kaiju keeps a copy of every original.
  • Convert MS to Program, as on the KRONOS: right-click a multisample, pick any slot (an occupied one asks first). Select several multisamples (or the layers of an SFZ / SF2 instrument) to make one program with velocity layers MS1–MS8, even from different sample banks.
  • KRONOS / X ↔ KRONOS 2 / 3 factory order: libraries made for the other order are adapted on import, so their combis play the right factory programs. Kaiju also follows factory programs you moved in your PCG, and tells you which ones you erased.
  • Nautilus: save only some banks, add banks and add the set list section, written exactly as the Nautilus writes them.
  • Combis: the number of tracks no longer counts the unused timbres factory combis park on the default piano. "Turn off unused timbres" switches them off in one click.
  • Import: "Add bank" next to each bank in step 1; the import page starts empty every time; the slot picker shows the free slots left after what the import already uses.
  • In a new blank PCG, options with nothing to work on show greyed out instead of disappearing.
  • Fixes: a Kronos PCG could offer to add program banks that don't exist (U-14…U-33); the sidebar no longer jumps when it's shown again; "Clear" recent files asks first, and the list can be brought back from Settings; the About window shows complete.

Kaiju 0.9.5 beta

  • Nautilus support. Nautilus PCGs now open for editing: import sounds and set lists between Nautilus PCGs, move, swap and erase, edit combis, set lists and Global. Banks show the Nautilus names (A–T and a–t). For now the whole PCG is always saved; adding banks and saving only some banks are still Kronos-only.
  • Rubber-band selection: hold ⌥ (Option) and drag over the slots to select several at once (add ⇧ to keep what was selected).
  • Play the samples: in Multisamples, click a key to hear its zone's sample at that pitch. "Big keys" makes the keyboard wider to play it more comfortably.
  • New blank PCG no longer asks for a PCG to base it on: it starts from scratch.
  • Combis count their muted timbres too (Session Keys shows 8T instead of 1T).
  • Fixes: full screen and maximized windows no longer hide buttons or cut off the top; switching tabs no longer moves the window; the Set Lists view keeps its buttons when maximized.

Kaiju 0.9.4 beta

  • Save only some banks, like the Kronos does. "Save as new PCG…" now has the Kronos "Save PCG Data" page: tick banks of each type, Global settings, Drum Track patterns and set lists. If a ticked sound uses a bank you left out, Kaiju tells you and can add it.
  • New blank PCG (File menu): starts from your PCG's Global and INT banks with every user bank and set list empty. Fill it, then save just the banks you used.
  • Build and edit combis. Right click an empty combi slot › New combi here…, then "Add track" to put programs on its timbres. "Edit timbres & zones…" sets status, MIDI channel, mute, volume, pan, transpose and the key and velocity zones on a keyboard. Each MIDI channel gets its own colour, so layers and splits that play together are easy to spot.
  • Import: untick a program a combi brings to leave its timbres pointing at that slot (when the keyboard already has it), and tick programs in "Not imported" to bring them too.
  • Category view in Programs and Combis (and when choosing a program), like Category Select on the Kronos.
  • Set lists: copy and paste a whole set list (with its sounds when it comes from another PCG), assign a combi or program from a slot's right-click menu, empty a set list, a preview of the slot with its colour and font size, and a bigger window for the notes.
  • Move or copy a sound into an empty slot from its right-click menu, without going to the original first.
  • Add a missing bank with the "+" next to the bank buttons, and when changing a bank's type, choose where its programs go (or split them across two banks).
  • Unused programs: untick the ones you want to keep before erasing.
  • Rename the category names in the Global tab.
  • Kronos 3 PCGs checked. Sample files whose names changed when copied (an apostrophe that became "_") are found, with a warning that the keyboard won't load them as they are.
  • If Kaiju quit unexpectedly, it offers to send the report next time (your user name and folders are hidden; no PCG goes in).
  • Fixes: Kaiju could open with no window after being force-quit; spacing in the Global tab; EXi labels are green and no longer squeezed; the empty sample bank the Kronos writes by default isn't counted.

Kaiju 0.9.3 beta

  • A new welcome screen. The file you worked on last is at the top with a peek at its first set list; your drives are listed one line each (unfold to see their PCGs, eject from there); recent files show what's inside; plus tips and what's new.
  • WS & Drums is fixed. Clicking a wave sequence or drum kit selects it again, and the tab no longer slows down with big libraries.
  • Nautilus PCGs open read-only. You can browse their combis, programs, set lists, arpeggio patterns and Global; editing comes once it's tested on the keyboard. Files Kaiju doesn't recognise also open read-only instead of failing.
  • Samples found more often. A PCG opened from Desktop, Documents or Downloads now finds its .KSC in a folder with a similar name ("80s Booster V2.PCG" next to "80s Booster Sample Data").
  • No more orange dots on factory sounds. Sounds that use the factory EXs every Kronos loads (ROM Expansion, ROM Expansion 2…) or GM programs now show as factory. The orange "EXs not loaded" only appears when the .KSC load script next to the PCG leaves out an EXs the sound needs, and a program's details name the EXs it uses.
  • Sample badges fixed for PCGs saved with older Kronos OS versions.
  • Combis is now the first tab, and "Licensed to" shows on the welcome screen and the status bar.
